```yaml
name: Publish Connectors Pre‑Release Command

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [publish-connectors-prerelease]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Post start comment
        id: start_comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = context.payload.client_payload.pr_number;
            const sha = process.env.GITHUB_SHA.substring(0, 10);
            const body = `:rocket: **Publishing pre‑release connectors for PR #${prNumber}.** Expected image tags will include the SHA \`${sha}\` (10 chars).`;
            const { data: comment } = await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body
            });
            return comment.id;

      - name: Call publish_connectors workflow
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          release-type: pre-release
          modified: true

      - name: Post success comment
        if: success()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = context.payload.client_payload.pr_number;
            const body = `:white_check_mark: **Pre‑release connectors published successfully for PR #${prNumber}.**`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body
            });

      - name: Post failure comment
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = context.payload.client_payload.pr_number;
            const body = `:x: **Pre‑release connector publishing failed for PR #${prNumber}.** Please check the logs.`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body
            });
```
